hypothesis: Replacing hard winner-takes-all regression assignment with a fixed detached annealed assignment will improve small-K support geometry without changing the ASCENT architecture, data, or inference cardinality.
mechanism: All five modes receive distance-weighted SmoothL1 updates early in training; the fixed temperature schedule approaches hard assignment by epoch 20. The categorical head retains hard nearest-ADE cross-entropy.

data.window: 16 one-second observations to 24 five-second future points

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch; development metrics are diagnostic
training.formal_order: KAGC seeds then KBTP seeds, sequentially on one GPU

baselines: final unweighted Gibbs plus Energy-KL model
evaluation.uncertainty: seed outer and calendar-date inner paired bootstrap
evaluation.locked_test_gate: Freeze all ten train/development checkpoints and the evaluator before any aWTA test inference.

stopping_and_failure.stopping_rule: Always use epoch 20; no development checkpoint selection.
stopping_and_failure.smoke_gate: One deterministic capped KAGC run must finish with finite losses, finite gradients, and a reloadable checkpoint.
failure_criteria: Any target-test access before the evaluation receipt is frozen
Architecture, data split, optimizer, schedule, or cardinality deviation

claim_boundary: This is a matched training-objective baseline, not a new architecture. Test results will be retrospective and internally locked, not third-party blind evidence.
